summary: Token-destroying abilities no longer throw when the tokens are gone as the action resolves (Perplexing Guests discarding the target in the reaction window): Knowledge and Power, Fudoist Advisor, Mitsu's Fire Attack, Kano, training-move/destroy-token.
validation: New Knowledge and Power and Fudoist Advisor regressions fail without the change (ArgumentOutOfRange / InvalidOperation) and pass with it; soak seed 107 now finishes with no exception; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all passed.
remaining: Mitsu and Kano guards are untested (no way found to remove their own tokens in a window). A general 'target left play' rule is not implemented (needs a ruling).
